prompt: A photograph of a glazed ceramic piece on a wooden shelf, photographed as a real fired object. The piece is a lidded jar with a modelled hare crouched as the knob of the lid, glazed in a speckled iron glaze with the hare left in bare white porcelain. The glaze has run and pooled thick and dark in every recess and pulled thin and pale over every raised edge, a fine web of crazing runs through the glaze surface, the unglazed foot ring shows raw grogged clay, there is one kiln kiss where the piece touched a shelf, and three small pinholes where the glaze bubbled. Shot on a 100mm macro at f8, soft light from a north window camera-left, the wet specular sheen of the glaze reading against the matte raw clay, natural colour.
medium_blurb: Kiln-fired earthenware under a running glaze.
